_comment: Verified-date registry. `policy.js health` flags entries whose verified date is older than reviewEveryDays. When reviewing: web-search current state, update value + verified date, and propagate to shipping apps consistently.

anthropic-model-fast.notes: BYOK fast tier in shipping apps. Haiku 4.5 is still the current and only Haiku. ID is complete as written: Anthropic model IDs take no date suffix, and the previous value carried one. Reviewed every 60 days rather than 90: model families here now turn over faster than that window, and a superseded ID is not the only cost — Sonnet 5 replaced Sonnet 4.6 at a LOWER price ($2/$10 per MTok against $3/$15), so a stale entry can mean paying more for less. On review, compare price as well as capability, in both directions. Price at verification: $1.00/$5.00 per MTok input/output.

Reviewed every 60 days rather than 90: model families here now turn over faster than that window, and a superseded ID is not the only cost — Sonnet 5 replaced Sonnet 4.6 at a LOWER price ($2/$10 per MTok against $3/$15), so a stale entry can mean paying more for less. On review, compare price as well as capability, in both directions. Price at verification: $2.00/$10.00 per MTok input/output.

Reviewed every 60 days rather than 90: model families here now turn over faster than that window, and a superseded ID is not the only cost — Sonnet 5 replaced Sonnet 4.6 at a LOWER price ($2/$10 per MTok against $3/$15), so a stale entry can mean paying more for less. node-lts.notes: CI node-version in templates/ci.yml. Must match the local development major so CI resolves with the same npm. Node 24 is LTS (Krypton), ships npm 11. Verified against nodejs.org/dist/index.json.

gh-action-checkout.notes: Pinned by SHA in templates/ci.yml (3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1). Bumped v4.3.1 -> v7.0.1 for the Node 20 runner removal on 2026-09-23: v4 runs on node20, which stops existing on GitHub-hosted runners that day. v5 was the Node 24 move (needs runner >= v2.327.1, which GitHub-hosted already exceed); v6 persists credentials to a separate file; v7 blocks checking out fork PRs for pull_request_target and workflow_run. The template triggers only on push and pull_request, so the v7 restriction does not apply here. Review every 90 days rather than 180 — a runtime deprecation has a hard external date, and the old window would have expired after it.

gh-action-setup-node.notes: Pinned by SHA in templates/ci.yml (820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020). Bumped v4.4.0 -> v7.0.0 for the Node 20 runner removal on 2026-09-23. v5 was the Node 24 move; v6 limits automatic caching to npm, which is exactly what the template uses (`cache: npm`), so that break does not reach us; v7 migrates to ESM and adds cache-key outputs. Reads the Node version from .nvmrc via node-version-file — see the node-lts entry. Review every 90 days rather than 180.

gh-action-gitleaks.notes: Pinned by SHA in templates/ci.yml (e0c47f4f8be36e29cdc102c57e68cb5cbf0e8d1e). Bumped v2.3.9 -> v3.0.0, which is a runtime-only change: node20 -> node24, no changes to inputs, outputs or behaviour. Required before 2026-09-23, when Node 20 leaves the runners and v2 stops working regardless of ACTIONS_ALLOW_USE_UNSECURE_NODE_VERSION. Still the gitleaks action rather than a Betterleaks one; replace when Betterleaks publishes an action.

secret-scanner.notes: Homebrew only. Successor to gitleaks by same author.

claude-session-model.notes: Session model is the developer's choice. Mechanical subagents are pinned to haiku via ~/.claude/agents/ definitions.

socket-cli.notes: Socket CLI version in use locally (wrapper + socket:scan). Not pinned in CI — the template carries no Socket step by design; see project-standards § Supply Chain Security.
